items.quote: the official elevation of Denver is measured outside the west entrance to the building, where the fifteenth step is engraved with the words "One Mile Above Sea Level"
items.note: Answer is right. Worth knowing for a heckler: there are three mile-high markers (15th step original, 18th step 1969, 13th step 2003 as the accurate one). The question says 'an engraved step', so it holds either way.
